formal_statement: ∀ R m0 : ℕ, ∃ (m r d : ℕ) (G : MvPolynomial (Fin d) ℂ) (g : Fin m × Fin m → MvPolynomial (Fin d) ℂ), m0 ≤ m ∧ 1 ≤ m ∧ 2 ≤ r ∧ 2 ≤ d ∧ R * m ^ 2 ≤ (r - 1) * (d - 1) ∧ G.IsHomogeneous r ∧ (∀ x : Fin d → ℂ, (∀ i, MvPolynomial.eval x (MvPolynomial.pderiv i G) = 0) → x = 0) ∧ (∀ i, (g i).totalDegree ≤ 1) ∧ MvPolynomial.bind₁ g (PEqualNP.Gct.permPoly ℂ m) = G
plain_statement: For every R there are arbitrarily large m such that an affine substitution turns perm_m into a complex form of degree r in d variables whose partials vanish together only at the origin, with (r-1)(d-1) at least R m^2. Our construction (conjecture): the block sum of N copies of the sum of all r x r subpermanents of an a x 2r matrix, sharing the top rows, of permanent size a + 3rN - r; rows forced into a subspace where the elementary symmetric polynomial e_r has no singular point; then L-gct-053. Feeds L-gct-024 to give the superquadratic bound.
title: The permanent restricts to smooth forms with (r-1)(d-1) / m^2 unbounded
